title: Hitokiri
summary: Hitokiri is a quick and agile warrior with the face of an Oni. He has red skin and dresses in samurai armor. This Titan utilizes a deadly katana and can often rely on his considerable speed and Japanese fighting techniques in battle.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Harrison Fears obtained the Amulet of Hitokiri some time after joining the Blood Spiral and was used in training at the Blood Spiral Base. He fought against Tantras and Jericho and was disorientated by Tantras' Runamok power, before being called back by Harrison.

Later, Harrison summoned Hitokiri again in the streets of Venice to fight against Den Fears' Freelancer. Hitokiri was able to split Freelancer's shield into two but was defeated after a fierce battle. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

Hitokiri was used by Harrison again to fight against Den in the war of the Spiral against the Casterwill family members assembled in the Fortress of Iron Will, but the forces of the Blood Spiral later retreated with Harrison and Zhalia Moon when ordered by Tantras and, thus, Hitokiri was called back to his Amulet. [The Spiral War]

Hitokiri was summoned by Harrison once again to fight against Lok Lambert, Cherit, and Powerbonded Sabriel at the Castle of Vlad Dracul. He was able to overpower and injure to Sabriel but was defeated when Cherit gave Sabriel a power boost. [Lok's Leadership]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Hitokiri can use his speed to attack before a Seeker has time to properly react. And his skill with the sword he carries on his back is impressive. His sword is also sharp enough to split a shield in half as when he sliced [[Freelancer]]'s shield in to two. {{Source|Boys Will Be Seekers}}

{{Clear}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Hitokiri's summoning command is '''Strike them'''.
* Hitokiri is based on the [[wikipedia:Four Hitokiri of the Bakumatsu|Hitokiri of the Bakumatsu]], four samurai from the mid-1800's, named after the Japanese word ''Hitokiri'', meaning "man-slayer." The legend of the [[wikipedia:Oni|Oni]] greatly influenced the design of his face mask.
